decisions.rationale: Result of the declared scanner examination: true records at least one signature match (possibly with incomplete scope); false requires completed declared scope. Matches may be false positives; neither value establishes global virus absence, historical infection or actual malware execution.
decisions.scope_assumption: Use the exact scanner.detections_found Boolean for the declared source examination. TRUE requires at least one recorded signature match and can coexist with incomplete scan scope. FALSE requires completion of the declared scope according to the reader. Before launch, bind scanner tool/version/signatures, source receipt, examined input and exclusions, completion/failures and selected-case exhibit scope; current leaf/row compatibility does not enforce these source/scope constraints. This is the public schema narrow scanner-result interpretation, not a global virus-presence claim.
